summary: Iteration 16 — Regression test after user_public() refactor (_id removed, only 'id' returned). Backend pytest suite (5/5 PASS) + Playwright end-to-end UI (all 4 requested scenarios PASS) confirm: (a) POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with body {id,email,name,role} and NO '_id'; (b) GET /api/auth/me returns 200 with same shape and NO '_id'; (c) admin@relaispoint.fr/admin123 login succeeds, toast 'Connexion réussie' visible, header-add-point-btn / change-password-btn / logout-btn all visible; (d) session persists on page reload (cookie httpOnly restore, /me = 200); (e) logout hides admin UI + restores open-auth-btn; (f) re-login works with the same credentials. Wrong password still returns 401 with 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' (no 'Session expirée'). The 4 user custom points (Intermarche, Loker Lidl Léon Blum, Locker Super-U, Tabac du Lavoir Pirey) are intact — no create/delete performed.

test_scenarios_verified.1_admin_login_success: PASS — login body = {'id':'6a5502e1a4db760b1fb051df','email':'admin@relaispoint.fr','name':'Admin','role':'admin'}. Toast 'Connexion réussie' shown, modal closed, admin buttons visible.
test_scenarios_verified.2_session_persistence_on_reload: PASS — after page.reload(), /api/auth/me returns 200 with same {id,email,name,role} body; header-add-point-btn + logout-btn still visible; '4 points relais' displayed.
test_scenarios_verified.3_id_not_underscore_id_in_responses: PASS — both /auth/login and /auth/me responses contain 'id' key and DO NOT contain '_id' key (verified in both pytest and Playwright network capture).
test_scenarios_verified.4_logout_then_relogin: PASS — logout-btn hides admin UI, open-auth-btn reappears, re-login succeeds and admin UI restored.

critical_code_review_comments: user_public() in server.py:150 now correctly projects only {id, email, name, role}. '_id' ObjectId leak is fixed for both /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me — matches project guideline 'Always exclude mongodb ObjectId _id'.
AuthContext / frontend does not depend on user._id (only user.role for isAdmin), so the change is backwards compatible.
No other regressions introduced by the refactor.
